'''Advocate''' is the office held by volunteer officers of the [[Players Committee]], historically the Advocate Council or Player Advocates. The current '''Lead Advocate''' (Head Advocate) is [[Scott Lingrell]].<ref name="orgchart2024" /> Dated rosters are at [[Players Committee advocates]].

== Current Head / Lead Advocate ==

* [[Scott Lingrell]] — Lead Advocate on the public PC organization charts (2021 and 2024); his [[GEMP]] handle is also '''advocate'''.<ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>
